name: Harvest Ridge Winery
blurb: A winery on the Maryland line at Marydel, open seven days with a tasting room and outdoor space. The only one of these that publishes what it does about dogs, and it's a yes.

dogs.note: The winery's own wording: "Friendly, leashed dogs are always welcome in our outdoor areas." It says nothing about the tasting room, so assume outside.

tasting: $25 for a tasting with a tour, six wines. $15 for a flight of four you choose.

onSite.label: Outdoor areas
onSite.note: Where the dogs go. The winery names them as the dog-friendly part without describing them further.

onSite.label: A second site
onSite.note: There's a Pennsylvania tasting room at Toughkenamon with its own hours. Don't drive to the wrong one.

warnings: Marydel straddles the state line. The winery is on the Delaware side; the town name belongs to both.

sources.label: Harvest Ridge Winery: visit
sources.note: The operator. Gives the Westville Road address, the phone number, tasting room hours for both locations, the $25 tour-and-tasting and $15 flight prices, and the dog policy quoted above.

outstanding: Ask whether dogs are allowed in the tasting room itself, or outdoor areas only.
Confirm whether the outdoor area is covered — it decides the answer on a wet day.
Confirm whether food is served or whether it's wine only.

name: Thompson Island Brewing Company
blurb: A brewery with a fifteen-barrel brewhouse, wood-fired food and a large beer garden, minutes from the Rehoboth beach. Open every day, late.

dogs.note: The brewery publishes no dog policy. Several guides say the outdoor tables are dog friendly; none of them is the brewery.

onSite.label: Beer garden
onSite.note: The brewery calls it spacious. There's a fire pit.

onSite.label: Food
onSite.note: Wood-fired, with seasonal specials. This is a restaurant as much as a taproom.

onSite.label: Music
onSite.note: Live, on the brewery's own account.

warnings: No published dog policy. If the dog is the reason you're going, ring 302-226-4677 first.

sources.label: Thompson Island Brewing Company
sources.note: The operator. Gives the Veterans Way address, the phone number, daily 11:30am to 10pm, the 4-6pm happy hour, the beer garden, fire pit, wood-fired food and live music. States no dog policy anywhere.

outstanding: Ring and get the dog policy. Every aggregator asserts one and the brewery publishes none.
Confirm whether the beer garden is covered or heated out of season.

name: Mispillion River Brewing
blurb: A Milford taproom open seven days and late on weekends — midnight-ish on a Friday, which almost nothing else in Kent County manages.

dogs.note: The brewery publishes no dog policy.

warnings: No published dog policy. Ring 302-491-6623 before you bring one.

sources.label: Mispillion River Brewing
sources.note: The operator. Gives the Mullet Run Street address, the phone number and the full week of taproom hours. States no dog policy.

outstanding: Ring and get the dog policy.
Confirm whether there's outdoor seating at all.
Confirm whether food is served or whether it's beer only.

name: Nassau Valley Vineyards
blurb: Delaware's first winery, in the fields behind Lewes. Tastings, tours, and a farmers' market on the site. It publishes almost nothing else about visiting, including its hours.

dogs.note: The winery publishes no dog policy.

hoursNote: From Visit Delaware rather than the winery's own site, which still publishes none. Corroboration, not confirmation.

onSite.label: Farmers' market
onSite.note: Run on the winery's own site. Days not published.

warnings: No published hours and no published dog policy. This is a ring-ahead, not a turn-up.

sources.label: Nassau Valley Vineyards
sources.note: The operator. Gives the Winery Way address and the phone number, describes tastings, tours, event hire and a farmers' market, and calls itself Delaware's first winery. Publishes no opening hours, no tasting fee and no dog policy. Note the https address redirects to http.

sources.label: Visit Delaware: Nassau Valley Vineyards
sources.note: State tourism listing, read 8 August 2026. Gives Mon–Sat 11–5 and Sun 12–5. Not the winery itself, so this record says where it came from.

outstanding: Get the hours from the winery itself. What's published now is a tourism listing.
Ring and get the dog policy.
Confirm which days the farmers' market runs.

name: Apothecary Brewing Co.
address: 2703 Philadelphia Pike, Suite A, Claymont, DE 19703
blurb: A taproom on the Philadelphia Pike at the top of the state, and one of the few here that says outright that your dog can come.

dogs.note: The brewery's own wording: well-behaved, leashed dogs are welcome.

sources.label: Apothecary Brewing Co.
sources.note: The operator. States that well-behaved leashed dogs are welcome. Read 8 August 2026.

outstanding: Get the opening hours off the operator — this is a newer taproom and its schedule moves.

name: Autumn Arch Beer Project
address: 810 Pencader Drive, Suite C, Newark, DE 19702
blurb: The most precisely worded dog policy of any brewery in the state: inside and out during ordinary hours, not at the bar, and not during the big events.

dogs.note: Dogs are welcome in the tasting room and outside during regular hours. Not at the bar itself, and restricted during festivals and large events — so a busy Saturday is the one to ring about.

sources.label: Autumn Arch Beer Project
sources.note: The operator. Dogs inside and outside during regular hours, not at the bar, with restrictions during festivals and large events. Read 8 August 2026.

outstanding: Get the hours, and ask which events count as 'large' — that's the difference between a wasted drive and a good afternoon.

name: Bellefonte Brewing Co.
address: 3605 Old Capitol Trail, Unit 8C, Wilmington, DE 19808
blurb: Old Capitol Trail, and dog-friendly by its own description. Not the old Brandywine site — that address is Brew Works North now.

dogs.note: The brewery describes itself as dog-friendly. It doesn't separate inside from out, so this site doesn't either.

warnings: This is the Old Capitol Trail location. The former Bellefonte site on Marsh Road is now Brew Works North, a different business.

sources.label: Bellefonte Brewing Co.
sources.note: The operator. Hours and the dog-friendly description. Read 8 August 2026.

outstanding: Ask whether dogs are allowed inside or only on the outdoor side.

name: Brew Works North
blurb: Wilmington Brew Works' second taproom. Dogs on Sundays only, noon to six — the narrowest dog window of any brewery here, and worth knowing before you drive.

dogs.note: Leashed, well-behaved dogs on Sundays between 12pm and 6pm, and only then. There's no licensed outdoor area, so the dog is inside or not at all.

warnings: Dogs Sunday 12–6 only. Any other day, or after six on a Sunday, and the answer is no.

sources.label: Wilmington Brew Works: Brew Works North
sources.note: The operator. Hours, the Sunday 12–6 dog window, and that there is no licensed outdoor area. Read 8 August 2026.

name: Dew Point Brewing Co.
blurb: In the Yorklyn mill valley, near Auburn Valley State Park. Dogs outside only.

dogs.note: Leashed, well-behaved dogs outside only. The operator is explicit that they don't come in.

sources.label: Dew Point Brewing: tasting room
sources.note: The operator. Hours, and dogs outside only. Read 8 August 2026.

name: JAKL Beer Works
blurb: Middletown, and a straight yes: well-behaved leashed dogs inside and out.

dogs.note: The brewery's own FAQ: well-behaved, leashed dogs are welcome inside and outside.

sources.label: JAKL Beer Works: about
sources.note: The operator's own FAQ. Dogs inside and outside, leashed and well behaved, plus the hours. Read 8 August 2026.

name: Twisted Irons Craft Brewing Co.
address: 303 Ruthar Drive, Suites E & F, Newark, DE 19711
blurb: Newark, and the official site says kid and dog friendly in those words.

dogs.note: The brewery describes itself as kid and dog friendly. It doesn't split inside from out.

sources.label: Twisted Irons Craft Brewing
sources.note: The operator. 'Kid & dog friendly', and the hours. Read 8 August 2026.

name: Wilmington Brew Works
blurb: Dogs on the patios and in the beer garden, and not inside. That distinction is the whole point of asking.

dogs.note: Dogs are allowed on the patios and in the beer garden. Indoors is people and service animals only.

sources.label: Wilmington Brew Works
sources.note: The operator. Hours, and dogs on the patios and beer garden but not indoors. Read 8 August 2026.

name: Salted Vines Vineyard & Winery
blurb: A working vineyard inland from Bethany. Dogs on the property and the patios, not in the tasting room.

dogs.note: The winery's own FAQ: leashed, well-behaved dogs on the property and patios, not inside the tasting-room building.

sources.label: Salted Vines: visit FAQs
sources.note: The operator's own FAQ. Dogs on the property and patios but not inside, plus the hours. Read 8 August 2026.

name: Twin Branch Winery
blurb: Delaware's fifth winery, back open after a land-use interruption, and dog-friendly in its own words.

dogs.note: The winery's About page describes it as dog-friendly. It doesn't separate inside from out.

sources.label: Twin Branch Winery: about
sources.note: The operator. Describes the winery as dog-friendly. Read 8 August 2026.

outstanding: Get the opening hours from the winery.

name: Brimming Horn Meadery — Milton
blurb: Mead, on the Lewes–Georgetown highway. Its own menu page says well-behaved children and pets are always welcome.

dogs.note: The meadery's own wording: well-behaved children and pets are always welcome.

onSite.label: Bear Cult Brewing
onSite.note: Bear Cult beers are poured here as well as mead — it's a beer operation sharing the site rather than a separate place to drive to.

sources.label: Brimming Horn Meadery: Milton menu
sources.note: The operator. States that well-behaved children and pets are always welcome. Read 8 August 2026.

outstanding: Get the opening hours for both locations.

name: Brimming Horn Meadery — Seaford
blurb: The second Brimming Horn, inland at Seaford. Same business, same published pet policy.

dogs.note: The business publishes one pet policy — well-behaved pets always welcome — and doesn't distinguish between its two sites. Whether Seaford differs is unconfirmed.

sources.label: Brimming Horn Meadery
sources.note: The operator. The pet policy is published for the business rather than per location. Read 8 August 2026.

outstanding: Confirm the pet policy applies at Seaford specifically, and get its hours.

name: Dogfish Head Milton Brewery
blurb: The production brewery and tasting room at Milton. One of very few tasting rooms in the state where a leashed dog can come inside.

dogs.note: Dogfish publishes a dogs page: well-behaved, leashed dogs are welcome inside the Milton tasting room.

warnings: This is the Milton brewery. The Rehoboth brewpub is a separate place and its dog rule isn't confirmed here.

sources.label: Dogfish Head: dogs at Dogfish
sources.note: The operator's own dog policy page, plus the Milton tasting room hours. Read 8 August 2026.
